capabilities: Set a target number of new words via the command palette
Disable editing and content deletion until the target is reached
Reset progress to zero while keeping the target setting
Stop all plugin functionality to restore editing
disambiguation: Not a word-count statistics display; it enforces a writing goal by blocking content deletion and editing until the target is met.
extras: Developed by TwoFive Labs; the README links to their X profile and requests donations.
problem: Obsidian's word count feature only reports totals; it offers no way to enforce a writing goal by restricting editing until new words are added.
summary: Writing discipline plugin that sets a word-count target and disables editing until you have added that many new words.
